# Voice fixture

`voice-input.wav` is synthetic MiniMax speech (Chinese (Mandarin)_Warm_Bestie), saying “今晚，先说说。想停的时候，随时停。” No real microphone recording or user conversation. 16 kHz mono PCM. Browser tests place copies into a mostly silent virtual microphone stream to test local pause detection. API responses are mocked in the regular E2E suite.
